meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 当用户询问senpi中显示的提示（Tip）时，Claude会先实时查询可用的提示列表，确认用户当前能看到哪些提示，再阅读对应功能的实际代码，最后用用户使用的语言给出深入、具体的原理解释，并附上代码文件路径。
howto.when: 当用户提到“Tip:”行、说出“give-me-tips”、询问某条提示的含义或相关功能如何工作时触发。

say.note: Claude会定位该提示并解释其实际机制。
会深入说明该提示的触发条件和作用。

howto.what_en: When the user asks about a senpi tip, Claude first queries the live tip list, checks which tips this user can actually see, then reads the real feature code, and finally explains the tip's mechanism in depth in the user's language, citing file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, or how a tipped feature works.

say_en.note: Claude locates and explains the tip's actual mechanism.

say_en.text: Tell me about the give-me-tips tip.
say_en.note: Explains the trigger conditions and purpose of this tip.
